entities.name: Mazepa & Hetmanate's Decline
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Hetman Ivan Mazepa's alliance with Sweden against Peter the Great, the Battle of Poltava (1709) crushing Ukrainian autonomy, the destruction of the Zaporizhian Sich (1709), Hetman Orlyk's exile constitution (1710), and Catherine the Great's final abolition of the Hetmanate (1764).
